title: Coniferous
summary: CONIFEROUS, adjective [Latin , to bear.] Bearing cones; producing hard, dry, scaly seed-vessels of a conical figure, as the pine, fir, cypress and beech.

inlines.v: CONIFEROUS, adjective [Latin , to bear.] Bearing cones; producing hard, dry, scaly seed-vessels of a conical figure, as the pine, fir, cypress and beech.
